title: Blueprint webhooks are never sent (After transition and SLA escalation)
zohoSource: live Zoho CRM (org943261092, full edition; read-only) + Zoho API docs

panels.caption: Transition and SLA run, other actions run, the webhook never arrives
Zoho Blueprint designer, transition AFTER: WEBHOOKS is one of the actions

rows.tavi: Never sent (Field Update in the same escalation runs)

notes: Receiver: a fresh webhook.site URL per case; it received the workflow webhooks normally.
The designer offers the Webhook action in both places, so admins can set it up and nothing happens.
Zoho API docs: state escalation actions include "webhooks" (https://www.zoho.com/crm/developer/docs/api/v8/create-blueprint.html).
WH-22: the webhook added on the TAVI designer screen is saved exactly like the API tests and is not sent either.
